plan_a_advantages: Includes a tempo run for threshold development.

reasoning: Plan A is the better training plan for a trail runner aiming to become faster. It incorporates a dedicated tempo run to build threshold strength, a crucial component for sustained speed on trails, alongside a structured aerobic base. Plan B, conversely, focuses almost entirely on recovery and easy runs, which while important, don't directly address the speed component. Plan A’s inclusion of a tempo session and a more varied approach to aerobic work will be more effective in developing the necessary physiological adaptations for improved trail running speed. Furthermore, the inclusion of cross-training provides a valuable opportunity to build strength and endurance without the impact of trail running.
